Package com.github.crittscott.somestacks.gametest

Class FabricGameTestSupport

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somestacks.gametest.FabricGameTestSupport
public final class FabricGameTestSupport extends Object
Fabric-native scaffolding for the GameTests: the namespaced template name and Transfer API storage access and the small transaction helpers used by adapter-specific tests. Everything loader-neutral lives in GameTestScaffold.
